inflation_rate_range.name: inflation_rate_range
inflation_rate_range.value: CAST("inflation_rate"."rate" AS REAL) >= -0.1 AND CAST("inflation_rate"."rate" AS REAL) <= 0.5

instrument_weight_range.name: instrument_weight_range
instrument_weight_range.value: CAST("instrument_weight"."weight" AS REAL) > 0 AND CAST("instrument_weight"."weight" AS REAL) <= 1

owner_inflation_range.name: owner_inflation_range
owner_inflation_range.value: CAST("owner"."inflation_rate" AS REAL) >= 0 AND CAST("owner"."inflation_rate" AS REAL) <= 0.5

tax_year_base_rate.name: tax_year_base_rate
tax_year_base_rate.value: "tax_year"."base_rate" IS NULL OR (CAST("tax_year"."base_rate" AS REAL) >= 0 AND CAST("tax_year"."base_rate" AS REAL) <= 0.2)

transactions_instrument_required.name: transactions_instrument_required
transactions_instrument_required.value: "transactions"."type" NOT IN ('buy', 'sell', 'dividend', 'split') OR "transactions"."instrument_id" IS NOT NULL

transactions_quantity_required.name: transactions_quantity_required
transactions_quantity_required.value: "transactions"."type" NOT IN ('buy', 'sell', 'split') OR "transactions"."quantity" IS NOT NULL
